Note: Task description mismatch - "Rename youtube-channel-ai to video-channel-manager" does not match the actual diff (SelfImprovementService.ts template skip logic).

Same review as previous for commit a675193:

```json
{
  "summary": "Added template skipping logic for inter-review, discussion, and meeting tasks to return default reflection template. Fixed review template detection to exclude inter-review tasks.",
  "learnings": [
    {"topic": "Regex patterns", "reminder": "Avoid overly broad patterns like /participat/i - use word boundaries /\\bparticipat/i"},
    {"topic": "Duplicate logic", "reminder": "Remove redundant checks like !title.includes('inter') when the pattern is already in skip list"},
    {"topic": "String matching", "reminder": "title.includes('inter') is fragile - matches 'internal', 'intervention'. Use precise regex instead"},
    {"topic": "Silent operations", "reminder": "Add debug logging when skipping to aid debugging"}
  ],
  "issues": [
    {"severity": "medium", "description": "/participat/i matches unintended words like 'participant', 'participating'"},
    {"severity": "medium", "description": "title.includes('inter') incorrectly excludes 'internal review', 'intervention review'"},
    {"severity": "low", "description": "Redundant !title.includes('inter') check - inter-review already in skip patterns"},
    {"severity": "low", "description": "No test coverage for new skip functionality"}
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    {"priority": "high", "suggestion": "Add tests for inter-review, discussion, meeting, participate returning default template"},
    {"priority": "medium", "suggestion": "Use /\\bparticipat/i instead of /participat/i"},
    {"priority": "medium", "suggestion": "Remove redundant !title.includes('inter') check"}
  ],
  "praise": ["Good separation with shouldSkipTemplate method", "static readonly for patterns is correct", "Efficient Array.some() usage"],
  "overallScore": 70,
  "codeQualityScore": 65,
  "testCoverageScore": 50,
  "documentationScore": 40
}
```
